_comment: Mutation testing per ADR-020. Scoped to packages/core because that is where a surviving mutant means a wrong score for a real person. Run with `pnpm mutate`.
_pluginsComment: pnpm's isolated node_modules means Stryker cannot auto-discover its plugins; they must be named explicitly or it fails with 'no TestRunner plugins were loaded'.
_thresholdComment: RATCHET, not an aspiration. `break` sits just below the measured score so it can never get WORSE without failing the build. Measured 65.03% 2026-08-12 (break 64); 80.42% 2026-08-13; then 80.39%, 80.02% and 79.85% across 2026-08-14 as ADR-031, ADR-032 and ADR-034 landed. ADR-023 E4 holds: >=75 overall, no extraction/scoring module below 60 (weakest experience.ts 69.36%). READ THE TREND, NOT THE PASS: four consecutive measurements have declined and headroom above `break` is now 0.85, below this project's usual ~1 point. Every one of those changes added defect-targeted tests, which pin the defect and not the surrounding arithmetic - see H-110. The next core change may well break the build, and the right response is to raise the score, NOT to lower `break`. NEVER lower it without a HONESTY_LOG entry saying why.
